summary: Frontend-only testing of the rename/rewire fix for consent windows and driver offline copy (iteration 28). All 8 requested checks PASS. On /auth/driver: two checkboxes present ('Принимаю условия сервиса' + 'Даю согласие на обработку персональных данных' with the word ПЕРСОНАЛЬНЫХ), driver-check-phone-btn is disabled with neither checked and enabled only when both are checked (verified). CRITICAL bug fix verified: clicking 'условия сервиса' link now opens modal with title 'Условия сервиса' and terms_text content ("Условия использования сервиса такси. Пользуясь сервисом, вы соглашаетесь с данными условиями.") — NOT the old 'Правила для водителей'/driver_rules_text. Clicking 'согласие на обработку персональных данных' link opens modal with title 'Согласие на обработку персональных данных' and privacy_text content ('Политика конфиденциальности. Мы обрабатываем...'). On /customer: checkbox says 'Согласен с правилами для заказчика' (old 'правилами платформы' not present), modal title is 'Правила для заказчика' with customer_rules_text content. On /driver (is_online forced to false in Mongo): heading is 'Вы не онлайн' (old 'Вы не на линии' absent), checkbox link is 'правилами для исполнителей' (old 'правилами платформы' absent), modal title 'Правила для исполнителя' with driver_rules_text content, and toggle-ready-btn text is 'Начать принимать заказы'. Admin panel /admin/login (admin@taxi.local/admin123) → nav-texts tab renders all 10 required editable fields (ui-text-agree_terms_link, ui-text-agree_privacy_link, ui-text-modal_terms_title, ui-text-modal_privacy_title, ui-text-customer_rules_link, ui-text-customer_rules_modal_title, ui-text-driver_rules_link, ui-text-driver_rules_modal_title, ui-text-driver_offline_title, ui-text-driver_go_online) and save-texts-btn. E2E edit flow: set ui-text-driver_go_online='Выйти на смену' → save → /driver shows button 'Выйти на смену'; cleared field → save → /driver shows default 'Начать принимать заказы'. Regression /customer order form works: 'Адрес и номер дома' field accepts 'Тверская 1', 'Разместить заказ' button is disabled before checkbox and becomes enabled after ticking 'Согласен с правилами для заказчика'. Backend URL from frontend/.env: https://order-sync-platform-1.preview.emergentagent.com. No screenshots or seed side-effects retained (driver reset to is_online=false only; ui_texts.driver_go_online restored to empty).
critical_code_review_comments: uiTexts.js correctly adds all new editable keys (agree_terms_link, agree_privacy_link, modal_terms_title, modal_privacy_title, customer_rules_link, customer_rules_modal_title, driver_rules_link, driver_rules_modal_title, driver_offline_title, driver_go_online) with proper Russian labels and defaults — good pattern.
AdminPanel.js remains 3547 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into per-tab components.

The consent-modal title/body pairs in DriverAuth.js/CustomerMain.js/DriverMain.js still use hardcoded strings for the modal body — only titles/link texts are ui_texts-editable. Bodies remain settings.terms_text / privacy_text / customer_rules_text / driver_rules_text (edited on Настройки tab). This is expected but worth documenting so the admin knows body text is edited separately from ui_texts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All rename fixes for consent/rules texts and 'Вы не онлайн' + 'Начать принимать заказы' are verified working end-to-end and admin-editable via ui_texts. If future tests need the driver on the offline screen, remember to set users.is_online=False in Mongo for +79007654321 first (visiting /driver does not auto-flip). Use nav-texts data-testid to reach the 'Тексты' tab; do NOT rely on get_by_text('Тексты') alone — the sidebar item has data-testid=nav-texts and the tab is inside AdminPanel.js after login via admin-email-input/admin-password-input/admin-login-btn.
rca of the issue: Original bug: DriverAuth.js Terms modal rendered driver_rules_text instead of terms_text, so tapping 'условия сервиса' showed 'Правила для водителей'. Fix (verified in DOM): modal for terms link now shows title from ui_texts.modal_terms_title (default 'Условия сервиса') and body from settings.terms_text. Confirmed by direct byline text comparison against GET /api/settings/public terms_text vs driver_rules_text (which differ).
